about: The motion layer (tools/ci/fx.mjs, src/lib/camera.tsx, src/lib/fx.ts; the owner 2026-10-06: the same trails, no camera, no motion). A film whose number is at least `from`, in one of `categories` ("all" or a list of ids), gets it: a camera on every scene, transitions on its cuts, an opening and an ending template. Earlier films and redos of them render exactly as before unless their spec says "fx": true; "fx": false or env VS_FX=0 turns it off. `stories`: the categories that get the story defaults (the stamp or loop ending, the handheld breath on photos).
auraFromAbout: The aura drop (tools/ci/aura.mjs, tools/ci/fx.mjs isAuraFilm; the owner 2026-10-07: "a SAD opening and BOOM"): a spec that drops ("opening": "aura-drop", a beat "drop": true) always gets the aura-drop opening; from film number `auraFrom` on, a film the ledger recorded with H21 or H22 gets it too, so the aura films made before (v78, v80, v81) render as they were made.
motion2FromAbout: Motion 2 (the owner, 2026-10-12: "Claude's motion design got stronger in the Opus update: we want that power too"): from film number `motion2From` on (a demo by its -vNN suffix, or a spec's "motion": 2) the plan says "motion": 2 and the render moves on springs: impacts with anticipation and a damped swing, transitions that land past their rest and settle, a carried velocity that settles on a spring, deeper parallax between the camera planes, words that reveal letter by letter and land on springs, and two new cuts (slide, iris). Earlier films keep "motion" 1 and render as made.
